name: Long Stretch

load.note: A heavier spring gives more support.

summary: Plank with hands on the footbar and feet against the shoulder blocks, moving the carriage from the shoulders.
steps: Hands on the footbar shoulder-width apart.
Feet against the shoulder rests; press up into a plank.
Breathe in to push away from the bar with straight arms; the carriage travels back.
Breathe out to draw the shoulders back over the wrists.

layers.title: Pulses
layers.text: Small pulses at the far point.

layers.title: With push-ups
layers.text: Add a push-up at the bar.

layers.title: Hold and bend
layers.text: Hold out and bend and straighten the knees.

modifications: Knees down on the carriage (see Kneeling Long Stretch).

cautions.note: Weight through the hands; offer forearms or swap.
Keep the range small; skip if painful.

cues:
The movement comes from the shoulders; the body is a plank being carried.
Hips don't lift on the way in or sag on the way out.
Arms straight, elbows soft.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
